capabilities: Publish the current note to a self-hosted Annotex server with one command
Copy a share link for invited colleagues to read and comment on the note
Keep a stable docId in frontmatter so links and comments survive renames and edits
Mirror annotations into a <note>.annotex.json sidecar beside the note
Sync annotations to the vault on demand via a command
disambiguation: Not a general PDF or web annotation tool; it only publishes notes to its own Annotex server and mirrors the resulting comments back into the vault.
extras: The plugin was not yet in the Community Plugins store at the time of the README; manual install, BRAT, or building from source are offered. The sidecar mirror is currently one-way (server to vault) and restore-on-publish is a planned follow-up. The plugin states it makes no requests beyond the configured server and no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share a rendered note privately with colleagues for inline comments while keeping a copy of those comments in the vault.

relations.evidence: This plugin needs an Annotex server — it's a companion to one you run yourself
Install the BRAT community plugin, then Add beta plugin

summary: Publishes the current note to a self-hosted Annotex server where invited colleagues leave inline anchored comments that mirror back into the vault.
